notes:
v0.1.10 — User services autostart + bigger defaults:
- ~/.winmux/services/*.sh launched by winmux-init on every boot, supervised with restart-on-crash (backoff 2-60s)
- New helper: winmux-svc add/list/start/stop/status/log/remove — solves 'no systemd, how to autostart bots?' problem
- Defaults bumped: 2G→4G RAM, 4→8 SMP. Edit winmux.toml if you want different
- Existing winmux.toml files are NOT touched — only new installs/configs use new defaults
